name.value: Las Shilas Mexican Street Food Vancouver

description.value: Las Shilas Mexican Street Food brings authentic Mexico City street food culture to New Westminster's Quayside Drive, serving handcrafted tacos with fillings like beef tongue, birria, and pastor alongside Mexican-style burgers and hot dogs. The kitchen leans into traditional Chilango flavors, with drinks including horchata, jamaica, and Mexican Coke rounding out the experience. Dine-in, pickup, and delivery are all available, and a catering program is in development.

address.value: 906 Quayside Drive, New Westminster, BC V3M 0L5

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: stands at 44m; rack at 93m.

concerns: OSM name appends 'Vancouver' but the confirmed address is New Westminster, BC — appears to be a deliberate branding choice rather than a location error.

Website describes a pop-up operating model with limited service days; cyclists should verify current availability before visiting.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating Mexican street food restaurant with a confirmed address, active Shopify-powered website, and clear service offerings. A useful food stop for cyclists riding the New Westminster Quayside waterfront.
